summary: On May 1, 2026, Graham Holdings Co disclosed via Form 8-K that its subsidiary Kaplan closed the sale of the Kaplan Languages Group (KLG). No purchase price, premium, or buyer name is disclosed; the company preliminarily expects a $60 million U.S. income tax benefit in 2026 from the transaction. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is minimal, serving as a closing notice under Item 8.01. Watch for subsequent quarterly filings to reveal after-tax gain and any earnout terms; risk-arb spread is not calculable without price terms.
